_comment: (10.11) After Milo's fight, when you came with the Peace Gun (core_fight.py -> Game.after_boss). Only Milo speaks, in silence (11.11). When he first says 'Void' the Void's music starts. The Void portal behind the heart is open now.

lines.text: Breaking it won't help. It never did.
The heart doesn't hold anything down. It only makes us forget.
Every time something goes wrong here, the system cuts it out. A bad day. A broken promise. A person who asked too many questions.
It all has to go somewhere. There's a place under all of this.
No sky. No ground you can trust. Islands of whatever was left, and bridges that only go where they want to.
You can see across the cracks. You can't cross them. You'll walk in circles and swear you went straight.
Nothing there is alive. It's only remembered. And it remembers back.
Look away for too long and it forgets you were ever there. Even the way back.
Everything the system took is down there. Every answer you came for.
I won't stop you anymore. I don't think I could.
The way down is open now. Behind the heart.
Go. And if you meet me down there... don't believe everything I say.
